facts.claim_en: In Arizona, a personal representative is a fiduciary who must meet the standards of care that apply to trustees.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, el representante personal es un fiduciario que debe cumplir las normas de cuidado que se aplican a los fideicomisarios.
facts.quote: a personal representative is a fiduciary who shall observe the standards of care applicable to trustees

facts.claim_en: In Arizona, the personal representative must tell the heirs and beneficiaries about the appointment within thirty days.

facts.claim_es: En Arizona, el representante personal debe preparar un inventario de la herencia dentro de noventa días después del nombramiento.

facts.claim_en: In Idaho, a personal representative is a fiduciary held to the standards of care that apply to trustees.

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, the executor or administrator must file an inventory with the probate court within three months after appointment, unless the court extends the time.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el albacea o administrador debe presentar un inventario ante el tribunal testamentario dentro de tres meses después del nombramiento, salvo que el tribunal extienda el plazo.
facts.quote: Within three months after the date of the executor's or administrator's appointment, unless the probate court grants an extension of time for good cause shown, the executor or administrator shall file with the cou

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, the inventory lists values as of the date of death.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el inventario indica los valores a la fecha de la muerte.
facts.quote: The inventory shall set forth values as of the date of death of the decedent.

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, an executor or administrator who distributes estate assets within three months after the death can be personally liable to certain creditors.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, el albacea o administrador que reparte bienes de la herencia dentro de tres meses después de la muerte puede responder personalmente ante ciertos acreedores.
facts.quote: If the executor or administrator distributes any part of the assets of the estate within three months after the death of the decedent, the executor or administrator shall be personally liable

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, the estate representative must file a verified inventory in court within 60 days after letters are issued.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el representante de la herencia debe presentar un inventario verificado ante el tribunal dentro de 60 días después de emitidas las cartas.
facts.quote: Within 60 days after the issuance of his letters the representative of the estate of a decedent or ward shall file in the court a verified inventory

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, property found after the inventory is filed must be added in a supplemental inventory within 60 days.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, los bienes encontrados después del inventario deben agregarse en un inventario suplementario dentro de 60 días.
facts.quote: he shall file a supplemental inventory thereof within 60 days after it comes to his knowledge

facts.claim_en: In Illinois, the representative must give an account within 60 days after the first 12 months from the issuance of letters.
facts.claim_es: En Illinois, el representante debe rendir cuentas dentro de 60 días después de los primeros 12 meses desde la emisión de las cartas.
facts.quote: within 60 days after the expiration of 12 months after the issuance of letters
